title: Why Mailer Boxes Work for Ecommerce Brands
excerpt: Mailer boxes are useful for ecommerce, subscription boxes and branded delivery. Learn why they improve protection and unboxing.
coverAlt: Open kraft mailer box with a folded garment and paper bag for ecommerce orders (concept image)

sections.heading: Strong delivery protection
sections.body: Mailer boxes are usually made from corrugated board, which helps protect products during delivery and handling.

sections.heading: Better unboxing experience
sections.body: A branded mailer box can improve customer experience by making delivery feel more professional and memorable.

sections.heading: Useful for many product types
sections.body: Mailer boxes are useful for apparel, cosmetics, subscription products, gifts, accessories and ecommerce product kits.

sections.heading: Custom printing and finishing
sections.body: Mailer boxes can include outside printing, inside printing, brand messages, stickers, inserts and premium unboxing details.

faqs.question: Can mailer boxes be printed inside and outside?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mailer boxes can be printed outside, inside or both depending on artwork, budget and brand requirement.

faqs.question: Which material is used for mailer boxes?
faqs.answer: Mailer boxes usually use corrugated stock such as E-flute, B-flute, micro flute or kraft corrugated board.
